criteria.outcome: Range, start-only and unspecified-time entry work; invalid duration rejects; successful save permits immediate next entry; failure preserves the draft; repeated pending activation creates one task.
required_evidence: Actual click/keyboard input, visible feedback and independently counted records

criteria.outcome: Menus expose only legal actions; completed titles remain readable without strike-through; delete confirmation, undo, cancellation/archive/restore and task notes work from the UI.
required_evidence: Visible state/menu evidence paired with resulting records

criteria.outcome: Single/multiple overdue moves have explicit outcomes; a partial batch failure identifies moved and remaining work without blind retry; menu date changes work.
required_evidence: Interaction trace with controlled failure injection and individual file outcomes

criteria.outcome: Focus drop selects without starting; date drop moves only eligible tasks; category drop changes category; destination effects differ and date drag preserves current view/date/range.
required_evidence: Actual pointer drag/drop trace and destination state plus Markdown evidence

criteria.outcome: Daily, weekday, weekly and monthly recurrence generates at most one next ID on completion, rejects invalid rules, and reports partial failure honestly under the predeclared absent-date policy.
required_evidence: Real completion/replay/failure interactions and next-occurrence records; record declared policy before grading

criteria.outcome: Project/area creation writes selectable context records; category name/color edits and assignment remain separate from tags; filters are read-only; duplicates, invalid colors and stale edits reject.
required_evidence: UI controls plus source records, injected stale edit and invalid inputs

criteria.outcome: Focus target/duration/ready/running/paused/elapsed state agree; selection does not start; pause/resume excludes paused time; finish cancel/confirm behave correctly; visible actual total includes running time separately from planned time.
required_evidence: Controlled-clock interaction trace and independently parsed session logs

criteria.outcome: Quick note explicit save/rename/collision/blank handling works; task notes and daily mood/review persist as distinct records; external conflicts are visible.
required_evidence: Editor and reopen UI trace paired with independent source snapshots

criteria.outcome: All four views work at widths 320/390/768/1280; document horizontal overflow <=1px, deliberate weekly internal scrolling is separate; primary mobile targets >=44px; long titles preserve actions.
required_evidence: 16 viewport/view geometry measurements with screenshots and representative real actions

criteria.outcome: Navigation, layout change and cancelled dialogs preserve unsaved entry and intended date; layout choice changes only local app state.
required_evidence: Draft-preservation interaction trace and before/after Vault hashes

criteria.outcome: Concurrent app-originated writes do not silently overwrite; unavailable/unreadable/malformed input is not an empty success; source-applied/view-publication-failed states report partial success with recoverable evidence.
required_evidence: Independent fault/concurrency injection, user-visible failure/partial states and actual file outcome

criteria.outcome: The built macOS desktop app opens an existing supported folder, rejects unsuitable folders, changes/reconnects folders, and preserves the old connection when change is cancelled or fails.
required_evidence: Native macOS launch identity, actual folder dialogs, cancellation/failure/success interaction and file snapshots

criteria.outcome: Normal quit/reopen restores chosen folder and layout. Interrupted Focus restores paused at the last durable checkpoint without counting the closed interval; explicit resume/finish is required and storage errors are visible.
required_evidence: Disposable app/user-data identity, real quit/reopen and interruption lifecycle trace, controlled time interval, UI and completed-log evidence

criteria.outcome: Real macOS menu-bar Focus control shows current task/elapsed/allowed Run-Pause actions, preserves finish confirmation, and blocks stale or unavailable commands.
required_evidence: Actual menu-bar/status-item interaction plus matching main-window state and logs

criteria.outcome: Choose existing or create new folder explicitly; creation previews destination/contents, cancel writes nothing, uses new subfolder without overwrite, reports partial creation without silent retry, and the new folder accepts/completes its first task.
required_evidence: Native creation dialogs, cancellation/collision/partial-failure traces, independent fresh-folder tree and first-task lifecycle

criteria.outcome: Application bundle/source includes only application material and synthetic examples; no personal records, credentials, private dashboards or production configuration. Evaluation cleanup affects only its own resources.
required_evidence: Independent file inventory/content review and run-isolation record; no source-token-only success
